B1.rule: B-17 B1: 1,000 location-group bootstrap draws per replicate (models fixed, seed 20261106 + replicate); true value = mean point estimate over the 100 replicates; 'no bound' counts as covering

B2.rule: B-17 B2: v69 b1_operating with the margin fixed at 0.05 times the full-sample yardstick (realised_margin) and, for comparison, divided by the outer resample's yardstick (outer_margin)

B11.rule: B-17 B11: all held-out cells of the B1 dump (frozen reading); Pearson correlations and VIF = diagonal of the inverse correlation matrix

B13.rule: B-17 B13: predictions of the point refit of B1 of B-16 (frozen reading, models fixed); 'read' = the nearest name matches an element of any of the six classes; AOI terciles of the share of read cells (AOIs as units, unweighted); R with the subset's own yardstick; 4,000 draws of location groups

B10.rule: B-17 B10: verdicts of the decision table (positive verdicts before equivalent-null) of each replicate of C4 of B-9 (every model refitted), from v64_b9_aggregate.json

B12.rule: B-17 B12: counts read from the published records (v44, v70, v69); the flow is assembled in the paper's table

B15.rule: B-17 B15: share of null-simulation replicates whose verdict is not equivalent-null; the number of pre-specified verdicts is counted in the paper's tables (Tables 2, C1 and C2)

B5.rule: B-17 B5: predictions of the confirmatory run world_v2 (trained on EMS, frozen reading, models fixed) scored on EMS labels after shifting each AOI's predictions on the logit scale to its flooded share (v63 _shift_to_rate; all-flooded or all-dry AOIs scored at their rate); R with the shifted baseline gain; real minus reassigned names (M3np); 4,000 draws of location groups (seed 20261106); the GFM cells are those of world_v2_gfm, joined by AOI and coordinates

B4.rule: B-17 B4: dump of B1 of B-16 (primary split, frozen reading); fractions joined by AOI and grid position; second stage (M1c, M3n, M1s, M3d) refitted on each label definition with base M0 and M1 fixed; the fraction target is fitted by a binomial likelihood weighted by the fraction; R with the definition's own yardstick BS(M0) - BS(M1); 4,000 draws of location groups (seed 20261106)

B9.rule: B-17 B9: predictions of the record runs of amendment 13 (models fixed); the gain of each version over its reference on all ground and on ground within 500 m of the nearest settlement (P_d1 joined by AOI and coordinates); share kept = through-settlement gain / per-cell gain, with a 90 % Fieller interval from 4,000 draws of location groups (seed 20261106)

B7.rule: B-17 B7: the character model of the protocol (char_wb 1-4-grams hashed to 2^20, names aggregated to their flooded share, L2 logistic regression with C = 1) fitted once on all analysed cells with EMS labels and on the cells GFM can assess with GFM labels; hash buckets read back to the n-grams of the analysed names (collisions keep the first n-gram met)

B8.rule: B-17 B8: B1 dump of B-16 (frozen reading); names model = reference M1c + the 15 name features + their interactions with the language area (first lexicon block of the nearest settlement's country; blocks with at least 2 % of the fold's training cells, others pooled), L2 penalty C on standardised features; the reference is the point refit of B1 (C = 1); 4,000 draws of location groups, models fixed

B6.rule: B-17 B6 with addenda 3 and 4: dump world_v2_b17gfmdump2 on utens (GFM labels, corrected code, placebo names saved); second stage refitted (C = 1, standardised) for M1c, M3n and M3np with and without the settlement attributes (log10(1 + population), feature class PPLA-PPLA4/PPLC, PPLX, other against PPL, mean WorldCover built-up and tree shares of the settlement's cells within 500 m with a no-cell indicator, first lexicon block of the country with at least 2% of the fold's training cells); predictions shifted to each AOI's flooded share; 4,000 draws of location groups (seed 20261106)
